summary: Full e2e testing of IRON HUB (Node/Express behind ASGI shim + React). Backend: 48 pytest cases across auth, users, plans, payments, exercises, workouts, sessions, stats and student routes — 48/48 passing (repeatable across 2 runs). A separate security suite (test_security_ownership.py) exposed 3 confirmed IDOR / mass-assignment failures. Frontend: all 3 login flows + redirects, admin CRUD (aluno, personal, plano, exercício, pagamento incl. mark-as-paid), personal flows (novo aluno auto-vinculado, exercício, treino com dias + exercícios do catálogo e overrides de séries/reps/carga/tempo, agenda criar/concluir/excluir) and the whole aluno mobile app (treino do dia, concluir, evolução, mensalidade, perfil, logout) verified working. ONE CRITICAL frontend crash was found and fixed by me (Hoje.js useEffect returning a Promise crashed the entire student app on tab change).

critical.issue: IDOR — no ownership check. Personal B can update/delete workouts belonging to Personal A (returns 200). Verified: test_personal_b_cannot_modify_personal_a_workout.
IDOR — no ownership check. Personal B can cancel/conclude/delete Personal A's sessions (returns 200). Verified: test_personal_b_cannot_modify_personal_a_session.

Mass assignment — req.body is spread straight into findByIdAndUpdate with no whitelist/validation. A personal can overwrite `personalId` (ownership transfer) and any other field. Verified: test_workout_personalid_cannot_be_overwritten.

minor.issue: No cascade / referential cleanup. Deleting an aluno leaves orphan Payments, Workouts, Sessions, WorkoutLogs and Measurements; admin dashboard 'Pagamentos Recentes' then renders the student name as '—' and stats/pendências still count the orphan amounts.
Any personal/admin can delete an exercise created by someone else (createdBy is stored but never enforced). Deleting a catalog exercise silently leaves stale copies embedded in existing workouts.

Brute-force counter is an in-memory Map keyed by ip:email — resets on every backend restart, is not shared across replicas, and never evicts entries (unbounded memory growth). Lockout itself works (5 fails -> 429).
cors({origin: true, credentials: true}) reflects ANY origin while allowing credentials. backend/.env defines CORS_ORIGINS but it is never read — use explicit origins from env.
Informational: bcryptjs produces $2a$ hashes (60 chars, valid bcrypt) not $2b$. seed_admin correctly re-hashes when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes — verified idempotent.
All DELETEs return 200 {ok:true} even when the id does not exist (no 404). Cosmetic/REST-correctness only.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER (1 line): `useEffect(load, [])` returned a Promise, so React invoked it as the cleanup fn on unmount -> 'TypeError: destroy is not a function'. The whole student SPA crashed as soon as the user left the 'Hoje' tab, making Evolução / Mensalidade / Perfil / logout completely unreachable. Changed to `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])`. Please review/keep this fix.
No React error boundary. Any render/effect error (as above) blanks the entire app instead of degrading gracefully.
API errors are swallowed with `.catch(() => {})`, so a failing request leaves the page stuck on 'Carregando...' forever with no error state or retry.

issues: Sonner toast is pinned top-right and visually covers the primary page action button ('+ Novo Aluno', '+ Nova Sessão', '+ Novo Plano') for ~4s after every save — reproduced on Alunos and Agenda screenshots. Move the toaster to bottom-right / top-center or add top offset.

Uses raw browser-native <input type="date"> / <input type="time"> pickers; the native picker UI clashes with the dark theme and the calendar icon is nearly invisible on the #1A1A1A surface. Consider a themed calendar component.
Missing data-testid on 2 of the 4 stat cards ('Treinos Ativos', 'Sessões de hoje' count) — only stat-meus-alunos and stat-concluidos-hoje exist, which makes those metrics untestable.
'Treinos concluídos (N)' counter and the Empty state have no data-testid; also no loading skeleton, so the section flashes empty before /student/history resolves.

action_items: Add ownership guards to PUT/DELETE /api/workouts/:id and /api/sessions/:id (personal may only touch rows where personalId === req.user._id) — currently cross-personal IDOR.
Whitelist updatable fields on all PUT handlers instead of spreading req.body into findByIdAndUpdate (personalId/studentId/createdBy must never be client-settable).

Keep the Hoje.js useEffect fix; audit for the same pattern elsewhere (Alunos.js / Pagamentos.js / Agenda.js / Treinos.js use `useEffect(load, [])` but their `load` returns undefined, so they are safe today — wrap them anyway to prevent regressions).
Add an error boundary in App.js and real error states instead of `.catch(() => {})`.
Cascade-delete (or soft-delete) dependent Payments/Workouts/Sessions/WorkoutLogs/Measurements when a user is removed.
Read CORS_ORIGINS from backend/.env instead of `origin: true` with credentials.
Reposition the Sonner toaster so it stops covering the page's primary action button.
Add data-testid to the missing PersonalDashboard stat cards.
critical_code_review_comments: src/routes/workouts.js:27 & src/routes/sessions.js:21 — findByIdAndUpdate/findByIdAndDelete without a personalId ownership filter = horizontal privilege escalation between personals.

src/routes/workouts.js:28, sessions.js:22, exercises.js:20, payments.js:24 — `{...req.body}` / `req.body` passed directly to Mongoose update: no schema-level validation of client input, allows ownership fields to be rewritten.
src/routes/auth.js:7 — module-level `attempts` Map is not restart-safe, not multi-instance safe, and never pruned.
src/index.js:19 — `cors({origin:true, credentials:true})` echoes any Origin with credentials; CORS_ORIGINS env key is dead config.
frontend/src/pages/student/Hoje.js:13 — `useEffect(load, [])` with a promise-returning `load` is an app-crashing React misuse (fixed).
frontend/src/pages/admin/*.js and personal/*.js repeat an identical modal+form+CRUD block (~60 lines each) — extract a shared useCrudResource hook / CrudTable component (DRY).

success_rate.backend: 94% (48/48 functional pass; 3/3 dedicated security-ownership cases fail)
success_rate.frontend: 97% (all flows pass after the 1 critical crash fix)

rca_of_the_issue: Student app blank-screen crash: /app/frontend/src/pages/student/Hoje.js used `useEffect(load, [])` where `load = () => api.get('/student/today').then(...)`. React treats an effect's return value as the cleanup function; here it received a Promise and called `destroy()` on it during unmount, throwing 'TypeError: destroy is not a function' inside commitHookEffectListUnmount. Reproduction: login as aluno@academia.com -> tap 'Evolução' in the bottom nav -> React unmounts Hoje -> whole tree crashes, Evolução/Mensalidade/Perfil/logout unreachable. Mitigation applied: wrap in `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])`. IDOR issues: workouts/sessions PUT+DELETE call findByIdAndUpdate/findByIdAndDelete with only requireRole('admin','personal') and no `personalId: req.user._id` filter, so any authenticated personal can mutate another personal's records; the same handlers spread req.body unvalidated, letting a client rewrite personalId/studentId.
